Matrix

Source: R/matrix.R
MatrixClass.Rd

Displays a matrix: entries made with element_to_mobject (by default MathTex()) laid out in a grid between brackets. DecimalMatrix(), IntegerMatrix() and MobjectMatrix() use DecimalNumber(), Integer() and the given mobjects as entries.

Methods: get_rows(), get_columns(), get_entries(), get_brackets(), get_mob_matrix(), set_row_colors(...), set_column_colors(...) and add_background_to_entries().

Usage

Matrix(
  matrix,
  v_buff = 0.8,
  h_buff = 1.3,
  bracket_h_buff = MED_SMALL_BUFF,
  bracket_v_buff = MED_SMALL_BUFF,
  add_background_rectangles_to_entries = FALSE,
  include_background_rectangle = FALSE,
  element_to_mobject = MathTex,
  element_to_mobject_config = list(),
  element_alignment_corner = DR,
  left_bracket = "[",
  right_bracket = "]",
  stretch_brackets = TRUE,
  bracket_config = list(),
  ...
)

DecimalMatrix(
  matrix,
  element_to_mobject = DecimalNumber,
  element_to_mobject_config = list(num_decimal_places = 1),
  ...
)

IntegerMatrix(matrix, element_to_mobject = Integer, ...)

MobjectMatrix(matrix, element_to_mobject = function(m) m, ...)

Arguments

matrix

An R matrix, a data frame, a list of rows (vectors or lists), or a vector (one column).

v_buff, h_buff

Vertical and horizontal distance between entries.

bracket_h_buff

Distance of the brackets from the entries.

bracket_v_buff

How far the brackets extend above and below the entries.

add_background_rectangles_to_entries

Add a background rectangle to each entry.

include_background_rectangle

Add a background rectangle to the matrix.

element_to_mobject

Constructor applied to each entry.

element_to_mobject_config

Named list of extra arguments for it.

element_alignment_corner

Corner of each entry aligned to the grid.

left_bracket, right_bracket

LaTeX bracket delimiters, such as "(" or "[".

stretch_brackets

Stretch the brackets to the height of the entries.

bracket_config

Named list of arguments for the bracket MathTex().

...

Passed to VMobject().

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Needs LaTeX and dvisvgm.
Matrix(list(list(2, "\\pi"), list(-1, 1)))
IntegerMatrix(rbind(c(3.7, 2), c(42.2, 12)), left_bracket = "(", right_bracket = ")")
} # }
